ImageDescription.value:
Schiessentümpel (View of the waterfall from the bridge) in Müllerthal, Luxembourg
The Schiessentümpel (also known as Schéissendëmpel) is a picturesque waterfall in the Müllerthal, also known as “Little Luxembourg Switzerland”. It is located near the village of Waldbillig and is one of the country’s most famous natural attractions.
The Schiessentümpel is formed where the Schwarze Ernz stream cascades down several sandstone steps. The water splits into three cascades that flow into a small pool. The surrounding rocks and dense forest give the place a romantic, almost fairy-tale atmosphere.
The stone arch bridge from 1879, which crosses the waterfall, is particularly striking. It was built as part of the expansion of hiking trails and is now a popular photo motif.
The Schiessentümpel is a nature reserve and part of the Müllerthal Trail. It combines nature, history, and tourism to form a landmark of Luxembourg.

ImageDescription.value:
Amphycribral Vascular Bundle of a Fern Rhizome - Pterídium aquilínum

Big cells with red cell wall are tracheids. They serve in the transport of water. Around the xylem there are xylem parenchyma and phloem cells. A single row layer of small cells (with red content) located circumferentially is endoderm. In the parenchyma there are amyloplasts which store starch granules. Authorial prepared mount, polychrome painted tissues

ImageDescription.value:
Simple and easy apple pie served with vanilla ice cream, on a gingham tablecloth in Lysekil, Sweden. Image focus stacked from five photos using Photoshop.

Recipe:

  • Ingredients: 150 g butter, 1 dl sugar, 3 dl all-purpose flour, 1 dl rolled oats, 3 large apples
  • Directions: Mix sugar, flour and oats in a bowl. Cut the butter into smaller cubes and add to the mix. Work the butter into the dry ingredients using pinching and kneading motions, until the butter is evenly mixed in. The result should not be a smooth dough, but rather small lumps. Pour the lumps into a pan; a regular medium springform pan will do nicely. Work the lumpy dough so that it covers the bottom of the pan and a couple of cm up against the sides. Peel and slice the apples, and put them in the pan. Sprinkle with some sugar and cinnamon. Bake in the middle of oven at 225 °C for about 25-30 minutes. Allow to cool a bit before serving with vanilla ice cream.
